epic.description: Selection controls in QA Practice Hub.

story.description: Users can select and deselect skills independently.

test_cases.summary: Verify independent selection and deselection of skill checkboxes
test_cases.description: Proposed test design for Skills in the Selection section of https://qapracticehub.com/. Review before approval.
preconditions: Open QA Practice Hub and navigate to Selection.
All Skills checkboxes are initially unchecked.

steps.expected: Only Selenium is checked; Playwright, Cypress and Appium are unchecked.
Selenium and Playwright are checked; Cypress and Appium are unchecked.
All Skills checkboxes are unchecked and the Skills summary displays None selected.

acceptance_criteria: Changing one skill does not change another skill selected state.
Selected states and the Skills summary match the actions.
